item.title: a short note about the first sentence
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: the first sentence is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

The first sentence shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
